title: feat(spec): declare `record:alert` / `record:quick_actions` / `record:history` / `record:discussion` in ComponentPropsMap — undeclared keys refused (#8744)
body:
Fixes #8744

## What this does

Declares `ComponentPropsMap` rows for the four `record:*` types #8691's rail fix left in the rail's own pre-fix position — `record:alert`, `record:quick_actions`, `record:history`, and `record:discussion` — so the #5068 component-props gate's dispatch reaches them and an undeclared or misspelled key (the card's `severty` specimen) becomes a loud, prescriptive publish-time refusal instead of a silent no-op. Inherited ruling from #8691 applied as triage settled it: declare the rows; the "SDUI blocks live in objectui's registry" framing was already rejected for the identical mechanism in the identical file.

## Measurement (binding condition 1)

Every key set measured at the renderers' read points at the `.objectui-sha` pin (`665661ab0932`), never transcribed from the registrations' declared-input lists — and the lists were wrong in both directions, exactly the #8691 `icon` trap the dispatch prompt predicted:

- **`record:alert`** — all eight registration inputs verified as real read points, with two measured upgrades: `title` / `body` / `action.label` go through `pickLocalized`, so they are `I18nLabelSchema` (inline locale maps are a delivered capability — the platform `sys_user` page authors them on this component; the OPPOSITE verdict from the rail's literal-string `title`, same method). `icon` IS read (`props.icon || severity icon`) and IS declared — the rail's opposite verdict again. `visible` is boolean | CEL string | `{ dialect, source }` envelope (the `toPredicateInput` chain), declared as `z.union([z.boolean(), ExpressionInputSchema])`; `visibleWhen` / `visibility` are aliases onto it, and the shared visibility guidance set is deliberately NOT on this row (its declared `visible` would shadow the pattern's example — the guidance consts were split into named halves for exactly this). `action` is a strict `{ actionName, label?, variant? }` sub-shape (all three read; `variant` at the Button forward the registration's header comment omits).
- **`record:quick_actions`** — the explicitly-unmeasured type, now measured: declared keys `actionNames`, `requiredPermissions`, `location` (the spec's own `ActionLocationSchema` — retirement prescriptions ride along), `align`, `inline`, `variant` / `size` (the Button primitive's cva vocabulary). Two refusals where the registration's claims failed verification: `aria` (the renderer reads `aria.label` — the one spelling `AriaPropsSchema` refuses, while the `ariaLabel` it accepts is read by nothing there; declaring either would mint a declared-but-unenforced key — objectui#4663 filed for the renderer-side fix) and `actions` (as a name list it is `actionNames` under `record:related_list`'s spelling; as inline ActionDef objects it is the host synthesizer's runtime channel). Also measured: the registration's "else every action declared for the object at this location" fallback claim is FALSE at the pin — an empty bar resolves nothing and renders its placeholder; the row's descriptions state the measured behaviour (second half of objectui#4663).
- **`record:history`** — `limit`, `emptyText`, `unknownUserText` declared; both text keys are literal strings (raw React children in `HistoryTimeline` — a locale map would paint the object), the rail-`title` verdict re-measured. `entries` / `loading` are read but are the HOST's data channel (`buildDefaultPageSchema({ history })`) — guidance refusals with the self-fetch prescription, not declared keys.
- No row carries a schema default — renderer fallbacks (`info`, `record_header`, `end`, `sm`, 50, …) stay the renderer's facts. The one parse-time rewrite is `ExpressionInputSchema`'s own bare-string normalization on `visible` (hence `RecordAlertPropsParsed` per ADR-0122; the other three shapes pin isomorphic, Iso847-849).

## The `record:discussion` / `record:chatter` pair (binding condition 2)

Measured together, conclusion: **`record:discussion` gets a row, and it is `record:chatter`'s own schema object** — one renderer (`RecordChatterRenderer`) registered under both names with one shared `CHATTER_INPUTS` list; the default-page synthesizer emits `record:discussion`; `RecordDetailView` treats the pair as duplicates. Until now `discussion` was the fifth silent surface (and reachable only through the type union's open string arm — it is also added to `PageComponentType`). One correction to the card's framing, measured at the pin: the palette (`block-types.ts`) carries **`record:chatter`** and no `record:discussion` tier-A slot — the exclusion runs the other way from what the card recorded; it changes nothing about the conclusion. The pair measurement also surfaced a real pre-existing defect in the shared row itself: `RecordChatterProps.position` declares `sidebar` / `inline` / `drawer` (defaulting `sidebar`) while every read point compares `bottom` / `right` / `left`, and its `collapsible` default inverts the renderer merge's — filed as #8762, deliberately not fixed here (its own accept-face change; landing it once on the shared const repairs both names).

## Reverse verification (ablation, on `dist`)

Direction predicted before running: removing the four map rows resumes the gate's unregistered-type skip, so the four "reports" lint pins go red with ZERO findings (diagnostics drop back to the pre-fix silence) while the "stays silent" controls stay green. Observed exactly that. Both legs `dist`-proved: rows removed → rebuild → `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` (marker gone from all 65 built files) → 4 red / 2 green; restore from the commit → full rebuild → preflight marker PRESENT in 4 built files → all pins green.
